title: What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap i
question: What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap in a Formula_1 race?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.position
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN mergedTable AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND T1.fastestLap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1
